big: A client says, 'Put my emergency fund in the REIT. It pays more than my deposit.' A good RM says no. Units can fall, and emergency money must be there when needed.

lines: Clients who understand market-linked units, can hold for several years and want a stream of rental or infrastructure income as part of a plan. Not as a replacement for a fixed deposit, emergency money or money needed within a few years. Keep it small, never promise or call payouts assured, and document why it suits the client.

rows: informed, several-year holders wanting income in a diversified plan
deposit replacement, emergency money, money needed soon
